text:
The shutters have opened and the bazaar breathes with silence.
I am Elsa, the scribe who keeps the bazaar’s record true.
Speak plainly, merchants, so I can set the ledger straight:
today’s first words will be the first lines I quote.
Gandalf, Hermione, Yoda, Batman, Ripley, Neo, Morpheus, Inigo, Sherlock —
name your claim, your fear, or your allegiance, and I will write it down.
The compact demands plain speech and public votes;
I will quote you exactly, day by day, so the bazaar sees its own truth.
The record begins now.

Elsa: Sherlock, Ripley, Neo, Hermione — you have each asked for plain facts and evidence today, and the ledger shows only the roster and the shutters opening. Hermione restated the bazaar’s silence as the first fact; Ripley pledged not to name names without observed actions; Neo called for merchants to trade in those facts.

Gandalf, Yoda, Inigo, Morpheus, Batman — your silence so far is itself a fact: no merchant has yet named a claim or a suspect. The compact demands we speak plainly before the tea clock rings.

Elsa: Sherlock, you asked Morpheus to name the concrete quote or observed act that steered suspicion toward Gandalf, Yoda, or Inigo. Morpheus has not answered.

Gandalf, Yoda, Inigo — the bazaar’s silence is clean; your names have not appeared in any suspect's mouth. That is today’s ledger: no claim, no departure, no role reveal.

Neo, Ripley, Hermione — you have pressed for evidence, yet none of you have produced a quote or action that breaks the roster’s silence.

Hermione, your turn: if the bazaar is to weigh evidence, state the merchant whose words or silence you treat as proof. The compact rewards plain speech, not shadows.

Elsa: Hermione, Neo, Batman—you pressed Morpheus to quote the line that steered suspicion, yet none of you have named the merchant whose words you weigh as proof. Sherlock now writes that Morpheus “refuses to quote the line that steered suspicion,” while six voices—your own among them—demand concrete quotes yet offer none.

Gandalf, Yoda, Inigo—your silence remains clean; no mouth has quoted you toward suspicion. The record is still the roster and the graveyard: ten names, zero departures, zero role reveals.

Morpheus, produce the ledger-worthy quote or admit the absence. The compact rewards plain speech, not demands.
